hardware: Apple M1 Ultra (16 performance + 4 efficiency cores), 64 GB RAM, macOS 27.0.1; Python 3.13.7, torch 2.14.1 (16 CPU threads), sentence-transformers 6.1.0, rank-bm25 0.2.2, numpy 2.5.4. Quality rows ran on MPS (sentence-transformers' default device here); latency rows are labelled CPU or MPS.
note: Quality: BEIR SciFact test (300 queries, 5,183 docs, 5,852 chunks) and NFCorpus test (323 queries, 3,633 docs, 4,133 chunks), run through the lab's own NaiveRag / HybridRag / RerankedRag. hit@k = share of queries with at least one chunk from a relevant document in the top k (the lab's Recall@k). Differences carry paired-bootstrap 95% CIs over queries; with ~300 queries, gaps under ~4 points are noise. Latency: medians of 5 interleaved rounds of 50 queries after a warm-up. Other workloads shared the machine (1-minute load average 3-11), and absolute latencies varied up to 2-3x between three runs of the script on the same day; the ranges in the notes cover those runs. Ratios between stages were steadier. The bundled 5-document sample (src/eval.py) scores 5/5 for every version and is not a benchmark.
